briefing.headline: Three in four posts are text-only, yet text consistently underperforms; images run at 1.6x normal reach, the gap is the clearest lever available.

do_more.point: Add an image to any post you can. Images ran at 1.6x the account's normal reach across 18 posts, with half of them breaking the 1.5x threshold.
do_more.evidence: Image format outperformed every other format in both the 120-day and 30-day windows. The two top organic posts this month were event images.

do_more.point: Post more event content. It has been the top topic by reach for four months straight, with five times the hit rate of product posts.
do_more.evidence: Event posts held 1.18x and 1.17x reach across 120- and 30-day windows respectively. Hit rate was 32% vs. product feature's 6%.

do_more.point: More founder personal posts from @DevSecOpz. They produce the highest engagement rate of any topic and reliably outperform the account baseline.
do_more.evidence: Founder opinion/story held 1.07x reach consistently in both time windows, with 4.5% engagement, highest of any topic category tracked.

do_more.point: Open posts with a story or announcement hook. Both have held steady for four months; they're the only hooks with consistent above-average performance.
do_more.evidence: Story hooks averaged 1.11x (120-day) and 1.08x (30-day). Announcement hooks: 1.08x and 1.07x. Both stable while question hooks softened recently.

stop.point: Stop opening with bold claims. It's the highest-volume hook used, 110 posts in four months, but it consistently underperforms and is getting worse.
stop.evidence: Bold claim hooks averaged 0.94x reach over 120 days, dropping to 0.87x in the last 30 days across 64 posts. Hit rate was only 9% and 8%.

stop.point: Pause the automated series, eco-spotlight, themed posts, and pillars. None has produced a single above-threshold post across four months of output.
stop.evidence: All three automated series ran 0.79, 0.86x reach with a 0% hit rate across 51 combined posts in 120 days and 29 posts in the last 30.

stop.point: Stop posting product feature content without anchoring it to a specific threat or failure. It's the most-posted topic but the weakest performer, and it's declining.
stop.evidence: Product feature posts (70 posts) averaged only 0.97x reach with 6% hitting 1.5x. In the last 30 days, fell to 0.84x with just 3% hit rate.

stop.point: Stop posting in the 5, 9am PT window. It is consistently the worst time slot and is widening its gap from every other window.
stop.evidence: Early-morning slots averaged 0.86x reach over 84 posts (120 days), dropping to 0.80x over 49 posts in the last 30. Hit rate was only 7% and 6%.

writer_rules: Open with a question or a specific scene, never a declaration like 'AI is moving fast' or 'Your agent needs X.'
Write the first sentence to one person, not a crowd, 'you' beats 'organizations are.'
Anchor any product or security post to a named threat or failure mode; never lead with the feature name.
On X: keep posts to 120-240 characters; long X posts did slightly worse.
In founder posts, name the specific place, person, or moment, vague closers like 'Keep building!' and 'Classic.' bottom out consistently.
Tag accounts that are directly in the post's story; untagged posts underperform tagged ones across the full dataset.
briefing.caveats: LinkedIn reach is reactions+comments with no view counts, so its numbers aren't comparable to X; the top post in the dataset (628x) was a contest/image with likely unusual viral mechanics and is excluded from the image format interpretation above; TikTok and LinkedIn each have fewer than 7 scored posts, making those platform comparisons directional hints only.
